questionsAndAnswers: What is "What Is Paper Trading? Practice, Uses and Limitations" about?
Paper trading uses virtual money to explore order placement, portfolio arithmetic and record-keeping. It avoids real-money trades, but cannot reproduce all live-market costs or risks.
